psychological_meaning: Raw Umber evokes a sense of grounding, stability, and connection to nature. It is often associated with reliability, resilience, and a down-to-earth sensibility. This color can provide a feeling of comfort and security, reminiscent of natural materials and traditional craftsmanship.
